requirements.rule: Sugar-industry supplementary rule 25 (PDF p. 230): the once-only award at 25 uninterrupted years is modelled for clerical and manual workers in the sugar branch. Still missing: settlement before the threshold on death or permanent incapacity, qualifying direct transfers between sugar companies, and proof of uninterrupted service within the same company or group from the employment facts.
requirements.remediation: Represent early death or permanent-incapacity settlement, qualifying direct transfers, and uninterrupted company or group service as worker facts.
